Drainage-clip release-band fix — before / after contact sheet

20 cases, ranked by the old clustering-based leak metric (crossing_report.json). Rasters produced by the real calibrate dump CLI on the current HEAD (commit 5be6531), run twice per case with --clip-drainage 1 (after, the shipped default) and --clip-drainage 0 (before). No reimplementation.

Finding: the clip removes 0 cells in all 105 cases. Total release cells removed across this panel of 20: 0. I re-ran calibrate dump for the full 105-case panel (not just these 20) and every single case reports release_clipped_frac = 0.0 with the clip enabled (the shipped default). Before/after release-cell counts are identical for all 105.

Root cause: build_release only ever considers candidates where case.reference[i] is true (release is confined to the observed polygon — this predates the fix, unchanged by commit 5be6531). But descent_steps_to_outline seeds steps[i] = 0 for every cell where reference[i] is true, unconditionally, before any descent walk runs. So case.drains[i] is true by definition for every cell the clip is ever asked to filter — the check is tautological given how it's wired into build_release. The clip logic itself is correct in isolation (the unit test drainage_clip_separates_the_two_sides_of_a_ridge tests drains_to_outline directly, with cells outside reference, which is the case this bug can't reach through build_release). This is a wiring bug, not a bad idea: the clip needs to run against candidates that can be outside the observed polygon, not only inside it.
